subject: community-medicine
title: Oral Rehydration Therapy: Composition, Mechanism and Home Fluids

steps.title: Glucose carries sodium, sodium carries water
steps.tx: **Oral rehydration solution** exploits coupled transport: intestinal sodium-glucose cotransport stays intact even in secretory diarrhoea, so glucose drags sodium, and water follows osmotically. That preserved pathway is the entire physiological bet of oral rehydration therapy, and it holds in cholera as in childhood gastroenteritis.
steps.say: One transporter saves millions. Glucose drags sodium through a pathway secretory diarrhoea cannot shut, and water follows. That preserved cotransport is the whole physiological bet, holding even in cholera.

steps.title: Assessing dehydration before choosing fluids
steps.tx: **Dehydration assessment** sorts children by mental state, eyes, thirst drinking behaviour and skin pinch: alert with no signs (no dehydration), restless or irritable with sunken eyes and eager drinking (some dehydration), and lethargic with very sunken eyes, poor drinking and skin pinch returning very slowly (severe dehydration). Two signs in a column assign the class and its plan.
steps.say: Look, touch, then decide. Alert versus restless versus lethargic; normal versus sunken eyes; skin pinch snapping back versus lingering. Two signs in a column assign no, some or severe dehydration and with it the plan.

steps.tx: **Dehydration assessment** in a child with diarrhoea sorts four signs: mental state, eyes, thirst and drinking, and skin pinch. Alert with no abnormal signs means no dehydration. Restless or irritable, with sunken eyes and eager drinking, means some dehydration. Lethargic, with very sunken eyes, poor drinking, and a skin pinch returning very slowly, means severe dehydration. Two signs in the same column assign the class, and the class chooses the plan.
steps.say: Mental state, eyes, drinking, and skin pinch sort dehydration. Alert and normal signs mean none. Restlessness, sunken eyes, and eager drinking mean some. Lethargy, very sunken eyes, poor drinking, and a very slow skin pinch mean severe. Two signs in one column set the class and the plan.

steps.title: ORT is wider than ORS packets
steps.tx: **Oral rehydration therapy** includes packet ORS, sugar-salt solution, food-based fluids and home available fluids with continued feeding, not packets alone. Programmes teach mothers the home fluids first because diarrhoea begins at home at night, not at facilities. Packets anchor severe losses; kitchens anchor early ones.
steps.say: Therapy is wider than packets. Sugar-salt solution, food fluids and home drinks with continued feeding all count. Diarrhoea begins at home at night, so mothers learn kitchen fluids first and packets anchor heavier losses.

left.title: Home first fluids
points: Rice water, dal water, coconut water

steps.title: Plan A: treat at home, prevent dehydration
steps.tx: **Plan A** manages no dehydration at home: give extra fluid after each loose stool (50 to 100 ml under 2 years, 100 to 200 ml from 2 to 10 years, as much as wanted above), continue feeding and breastfeeding, add zinc, and return immediately for blood in stool, poor drinking, or worsening. Two ORS packets go home for use.
steps.say: No dehydration stays home with rules. Extra fluid after every stool by age band, feeding continued, zinc added, two packets sent along. Blood in stool, poor drinking or worsening means return at once.

steps.title: Plan B: ORS by weight over four hours
steps.tx: **Plan B** treats some dehydration at a facility or ORS corner: approximately 75 ml per kg of ORS over 4 hours, sipped steadily, with breastfeeding continued and reassessment at 4 hours. Vomiting pauses intake for 10 minutes, then slower resumption; most vomiting children still rehydrate orally, which is why Plan B succeeds in 95 percent plus of its cases.
steps.say: Some dehydration gets measured fluid: seventy five millilitres per kilogram over four hours, reassessed at the end. Vomiting pauses ten minutes, then slower sipping. Ninety five percent plus succeed without a drip.

nodes.label: Weigh child, calculate 75 ml per kg
Move to Plan A, repeat B, or escalate

steps.title: Continued feeding is treatment, not comfort
steps.tx: **Continued feeding** during diarrhoea protects nutrition and mucosal recovery: breastfeeding never stops, energy-dense local foods (khichdi, rice-dal porridge) continue in small frequent meals, and an extra meal daily for a week after recovery repays losses. Stopping feeds, the commonest home error, converts a 4-day illness into malnutrition's doorway.
steps.say: Feeding is therapy. Breastfeeding never stops, local energy foods continue in small frequent meals, and an extra daily meal for a week after repays losses. Stopping feeds turns four days of illness into malnutrition's doorway.

steps.title: Zinc: the adjunct that shortens illness
steps.tx: **Zinc supplementation** accompanies ORS for 14 days: 10 mg daily from 2 to 6 months and 20 mg daily above 6 months in common programme wording (5 to 10 mg in the youngest band in some texts). It reduces duration and severity of the episode and protects against subsequent episodes in following months, an effect ORS alone does not claim.
steps.say: Zinc rides beside ORS for fourteen days. Dose doubles after six months of age. Illness shortens and softens, and protection extends into following months, an effect rehydration alone never claimed.

steps.title: When oral therapy is not enough
steps.tx: **Escalation signs** override oral persistence: shock or severe dehydration, persistent vomiting defeating intake, unconsciousness or convulsions, ileus or abdominal distension, and glucose malabsorption with worsening stool output on ORS. These children need intravenous or nasogastric routes under supervision. Oral therapy's triumph is statistical, 95 percent plus, never absolute for every child.
steps.say: Know when mouths lose. Shock, defeating vomiting, unconsciousness, distended silent abdomen, or worsening output on ORS all escalate to drip or tube. Ninety five percent oral success still leaves a supervised minority.

steps.title: ORS corners and programme design
steps.tx: **ORS-zinc corners** at facilities put rehydration where triage happens, staffed by workers trained to assess, weigh, mix and observe for the 4-hour window rather than dispensing packets at a counter. Diarrhoeal disease control combines this with water, sanitation, rotavirus vaccination and nutrition, because rehydration saves the child in front of you while prevention empties the corner.
steps.say: Design puts fluid at triage. ORS-zinc corners assess, weigh, mix and observe for four hours instead of handing packets over counters. Water, sanitation, rotavirus vaccine and nutrition then empty the corner upstream.
